key_points: Yum! Brands agreed to sell Pizza Hut for $2.7 bn, reshaping the portfolio
CFO Ranjith Roy cites an “acceleration of growth” for remaining concepts (KFC, Taco Bell)
Analyst estimates upgraded, stock closed higher on earnings estimate rise
Dividend increased for the 9th consecutive year, supporting income‑focused investors
Focus on core brands expected to improve margins and simplify operations
